raw.transcript: If you don’t know the router password, you’ve got a few options. First, try the default login printed on a label on the router itself, or check the manual. If that doesn’t work, you can log into your internet provider’s account portal or app, since they sometimes show or sync the router credentials. If you still can’t get in, you can reset the router by holding the reset button for about 10 seconds, then set it up again from scratch. Just remember, that will wipe custom settings, so you’ll need to create a new Wi-Fi name and password afterward.
